anti_patterns_discovered_this_session.description: When two gsd-executor agents run in parallel in the same working tree, `git add .` or `git commit` (no pathspec) absorbs whatever the other agent has staged
anti_patterns_discovered_this_session.mitigation: Use explicit pathspec on every commit: `git commit -m '...' -- file1 file2`. Already worked successfully in Wave 1 (03-01 ∥ 03-02). Already in memory as feedback-parallel-wave-worktree-isolation.md.
